answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each peer identity to a scarce staked credential and throttle relay fanout so a single sparrow-like burst of new identities cannot amplify gossip beyond bounded out-degree. Peers that forge identities or flood the nebula of mesh links are demoted by Byzantine peer-score penalization, isolating colluding clusters before they propagate. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
